jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nerdio**

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

**About the role**

Nerdio is hiring a Digital Program Manager to orchestrate the scaled customer experience across Customer Success. You will own the automated journeys end to end, and act as an internal consultant to the rest of the CS organization: finding friction in the customer journey and removing it with automation and agentic AI.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success and work alongside the Pooled CS team, but your reach is wider: the plays you build are designed for reuse across Customer Success, so customers get one seamless experience no matter who owns the moment. This is a builder role with no named book of business. You bring the ownership and customer-first urgency of a CAM or TAM to cross-functional programs, and you are comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity.

**What you'll do**

**Orchestrate the scaled customer experience**

* Own the digital journey from onboarding through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion readiness. Build, launch, monitor, and iterate the plays and automations at each stage.
* Build the triggers and handoffs that bring in a CAM or TAM at the right moment (health thresholds, renewal risk, expansion signals, escalations, champion changes, customer requests), following the coverage model set by the strategy lead.
* Deliver against the current and future-state journey maps owned by the strategy lead. Surface the friction points you find in the data and in the field, and close them so the experience feels the same regardless of who owns the moment.

**Act as an internal consultant to Customer Success**

* Lead discovery with CS teams: ticket analysis, stakeholder interviews, and data review to find where manual, repetitive, or inconsistent work hurts customers or burns CAM/TAM capacity.
* Recommend and build the fix: automation, signal-based triggers, and agentic AI. Give teams plays they can turn on today.

**Lead agentic AI and automation**

* Move the program from static plays to adaptive, agentic journeys for higher-complexity moments, such as personalized onboarding and automated EBR/TVR one-pagers.
* Equip CAMs and TAMs with agentic insights that make their jobs easier and return capacity to them.
* Evaluate tools, run pilots, and set guardrails so AI-driven touches are accurate, on-brand, and hand off to a human when one is needed.

**Run the program and the partnerships**

* Own program and project management from discovery to launch to iteration: scope, plan, sequence, and keep a current view of the roadmap, status, and dependencies.
* Partner with Marketing on every lifecycle communication, RevOps on segmentation and metrics, Product on telemetry and in-app messaging, Support on ticket signals, and Sales on expansion.
* Prove impact. Tie each play to NRR, adoption, and risk reduction, run test-and-learn cycles, and share results broadly.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in digital customer success, lifecycle or adoption marketing, CS operations, or program management for a scaled customer segment.
* A track record of leading cross-functional programs from idea to launch and influencing partners without direct authority.
* A consultative approach: you can run discovery, facilitate working sessions, and turn what you hear into a prioritized plan.
* Hands-on experience with CS, marketing automation, or CRM platforms, and the ability to build or configure automated journeys.
* Practical experience with, or strong curiosity about, AI agents and LLM-based workflows, and sound judgment on where AI should and should not act.
* Data fluency: you use product telemetry, health scores, and attribution to choose what to build and show what worked.
* Strong prioritization, risk management, and written and verbal communication for audiences from CAMs to executives.
* A builder mentality and comfort with ambiguity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, cloud, or the Microsoft and MSP ecosystem.
* Experience with Partner Success or Support operations.
* Hands-on use of no-code or low-code agent builders and prompt design.

**Benefits and Incentives**

* Competitive Base and Incentive Plan
* Stock Options
* Health and Welfare Plans\*
* Life and Disability Plans\*
* Retirement Plan\*
* Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!
* Collaborative Team Culture
* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

Nerdio is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Nerdio is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
***We always do the right thing, the right way.***
==================================================

**Job Title: Senior Project Manager**

**Location:** Remote

**Department:** Engineering

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Compensation**: $120,000 – $145,000 + 10% AIP per year

**Summary:**

At Aptiv Interconnect, we inspire the world's most innovative teams by doing the right thing, the right way. We are seeking a strategic, high-caliber Project Manager to drive the execution of new product development and commercialization initiatives across multiple operating divisions.

Operating at the critical intersection of technical execution and business strategy, you will coordinate cross-functional teams spanning Engineering, Operations, Product Management, Sales, and Quality to deliver complex programs on time, within scope, and aligned with company goals. This role requires a hands-on, technically fluent, and highly organized professional capable of managing multiple parallel initiatives while driving clear accountability, risk mitigation, and continuous process improvement to advance our market leadership.

**Leadership & Core Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Project Management & Lifecycle Ownership**

* End-to-End Execution: Lead the complete project lifecycle from concept through commercial launch, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and fully aligned with business objectives.
* Cross-Functional Governance: Facilitate design reviews, tollgate meetings, and post-project evaluations while supporting the implementation of stage-gate product development processes and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Technical Execution**

* Team Coordiation & Communication: Lead and align cross-functional teams across Engineering, Operations, Product Management, Sales, and Quality, serving as a key liaison between Core Engineering and division-level stakeholders.
* Risk Mitigation & Resource Planning: Develop and maintain project schedules, resource plans, and risk registers to proactively identify and mitigate technical, resource, or timeline risks.

**Position Requirements:**

**Education & Technical Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a related field (Advanced degree preferred).
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive project management experience in a technical or manufacturing environment, with proven experience managing new product development (NPD) and commercialization projects.
* Industry Domain: Strong familiarity with product development methodologies, phase-gate processes, and engineering documentation practices.
* Regulatory Compliance: Citizenship status must be compliant with ITAR regulations (U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident/Green Card holder required).

**Certifications & Competencies:**

* Certifications: PMP certification or equivalent preferred.
* Systems Proficiency: Proficient in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, etc.).
* Core Competencies: Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills; hands-on problem solver with strong accountability, strategic decision-making, and multi-program management capabilities.

**Compensation, Benefits & Legal:**

**Total Rewards & Compensation**

* **Base Salary Range:** $120,000 – $145,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.
* **Incentive Compensation:** Performance bonus eligibility.
* **Benefits & Perks:** Employees receive a comprehensive benefits package featuring health coverage, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and career development resources.

**EEO Statement**

Aptiv is an Equal Opportunity Employer (Minorities/Women/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities). We adhere to all federal, state, and local laws governing non-discrimination and strictly prohibit workplace harassment of any kind.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is seeking a Program Manager to join the Data and Scientific Computing Service for Sustainment of GenISIS Team. The Program Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing the work of approximately 20+ technical professionals, including software developers, system administrators, and infrastructure support personnel. This individual ensures that projects, operational activities, and technical deliverables are completed on schedule, within scope, and in accordance with established quality standards.

The successful candidate will establish clear priorities, manage competing demands, track progress, identify risks, resolve project impediments, and communicate status to leadership and stakeholders. The position requires a strong foundation in project management, the ability to work effectively with diverse technical teams, and the leadership skills necessary to promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects and operational responsibilities in a dynamic technical environment.

This role is a fully remote position within the United States with core hours of operation from Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM ET.

Responsibilities:

* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource assignments.
* Break complex technical initiatives into manageable tasks with clear owners and deadlines.
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously and manage dependencies across development and systems administration teams.
* Monitor progress against established schedules and proactively address delays or resource conflicts.
* Ensure deliverables meet defined requirements, quality standards, and customer expectations.
* Maintain project documentation, action items, decisions, and change requests
* Establish clear expectations for task ownership, deadlines, status reporting, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular team meetings, project reviews, and individual follow-ups as appropriate.
* Identify workload imbalances and coordinate resources to address changing priorities.
* Understand the software development lifecycle, including requirements, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Understand systems administration responsibilities, including server and infrastructure management, operating systems, networking, storage, backups, security, patching, and system availability.
* Ensure development and infrastructure teams work together to resolve technical dependencies and operational issues.
* Track system support requests, operational tasks, defects, and technical debt.
* Prepare concise, accurate project status reports for leadership and stakeholders.
* Track milestones, schedule performance, resource utilization, risks, issues, and deliverable completion.
* Communicate project progress, upcoming deadlines, dependencies, and potential delays.
* Identify project risks, schedule conflicts, resource constraints, and potential delivery issues early.
* Develop mitigation plans and recommend corrective actions.
* Establish consistent project management practices, reporting standards, and documentation procedures.
* Improve task tracking, workflow management, resource allocation, and team communication.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 12 years of program management or technical program coordination experience.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating technical teams, preferably consisting of 10 or more professionals.
* Experience working with both software development and IT infrastructure or systems administration teams.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling, task tracking, risk management, and status reporting.
* Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.
* Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Ability to identify problems, make informed decisions, and drive issues to resolution.

**Clearance Required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* PMP, CAPM, or comparable project management certification.
* Experience managing teams in government, research, scientific computing, enterprise IT, or other complex technical environments.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and traditional project management methodologies.
* Experience with infrastructure operations, Linux or Windows administration, networking, storage, cloud platforms, or high-performance computing environments.
* Experience preparing executive-level status reports, performance metrics, and project documentation.
* Familiarity with IT service management, incident management, change management, and configuration management practices.

Posted Salary Range: USD $170,000.00 - USD $180,000.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
The **Implementation Manager** is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the installation, integration, testing, deployment, operational startup, and expansion of Customer Experience Quality Assurance (CQA) resources across all program phases. This role ensures seamless transition from design and testing into production operations by integrating technology, facilities, staffing, training, security, and operational readiness activities. The Implementation Manager manages dependencies, risk, resource scaling, and readiness gates to deliver successful operational launches and ongoing expansion initiatives.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of complex contact center, customer experience, and IT service delivery environments.
* Coordinate installation, integration, testing, deployment, and operational startup activities across multiple workstreams.
* Develop and manage integrated implementation schedules covering technology, facilities, workforce, training, security, and operational readiness.
* Establish and manage implementation milestones, dependencies, stage gates, and go-live readiness reviews.
* Coordinate system, user acceptance, operational, and production readiness testing activities.
* Manage transitions from development and testing environments into production operations.
* Oversee workforce ramp-up, capacity expansion, and scale-down activities to align with program requirements.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate implementation risks and issues that could impact schedule, budget, or operational performance.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams including program management, engineering, operations, training, security, and infrastructure stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with organizational, contractual, security, and operational requirements throughout implementation activities.
* Develop implementation plans, deployment strategies, contingency plans, and rollback procedures.
* Monitor implementation performance metrics and drive continuous improvement throughout deployment cycles.
* Support executive leadership with implementation status reporting, readiness assessments, and decision support.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10-15 years of experience implementing complex contact center, customer experience, or enterprise IT environments.
* At least 7 years of experience leading large-scale implementations, transitions, operational startups, or deployment programs.
* Demonstrated experience moving enterprise-scale systems from design and testing through production deployment.
* Experience rapidly scaling workforce, operational processes, and technology capacity in support of business growth or program expansion.
* Strong knowledge of implementation governance, program integration, dependency management, and risk management methodologies.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams and coordinating multiple concurrent implementation workstreams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification.
* SAFe Agilist (SA), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent Agile certification.
* Cloud platform certifications (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform) preferred.
* Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform certifications in solutions such as Five9, Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, or Cisco Webex Contact Center are advantageous.

### **Desired Skills**

* Program and implementation management
* Deployment planning and execution
* Operational readiness assessment
* Enterprise systems integration
* Contact center operations
* Risk and dependency management
* Workforce ramp planning
* Capacity management and forecasting
* Testing and transition management
* Cross-functional leadership
* Executive communications and reporting
* Change management and stakeholder engagement

### **Experience Highlights**

Successful candidates will have a proven track record of leading large-scale implementation efforts involving complex technology deployments, operational transitions, contact center modernization initiatives, CCaaS migrations, or enterprise service delivery programs. Experience managing implementation activities across technology, people, processes, facilities, and operations while meeting aggressive deployment schedules is highly desirable.

Position Contingency Notice  
  
This position is being recruited in support of an upcoming federal contract opportunity and is contingent upon contract award, funding, and final client approval. ITCON Services is proactively identifying qualified candidates in anticipation of the program's potential start. Candidates selected for consideration will be kept informed regarding the anticipated timeline and status of the opportunity throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Program Manager (contract)
jobs.description:
**Program Manager (Contract)**

*Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Microsoft through external staffing partners of Allegis Global Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by AGS and will not be an employee of Microsoft.*

**Summary:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Business Operations and Program Management professional to serve as the operational backbone for a senior cloud supply chain leadership organization. In this role, you will own and drive the rhythm of business, lead strategic planning initiatives, and produce executive-level communications that keep leadership teams aligned and moving forward. This is a high-visibility, fast-paced position that demands exceptional attention to detail, strong cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities with urgency and precision. You will work directly alongside senior leaders, acting as a "Chief of Staff–lite" operator who is equally at home designing cadence and process as crafting polished executive communications.

* Own and drive the rhythm of business (ROB) cadences including staff meetings, monthly business reviews (MBRs), quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and all-hands meetings
* Partner with leadership to develop and maintain a strategic roadmap, tracking progress against key initiatives and milestones
* Lead OKR development, tracking, and management across the organization, maintaining single-source-of-truth dashboards using Excel and/or Power BI
* Own organizational communications including newsletters, All-Team Meeting (ATM) content, and staff meeting decks at an executive-grade standard
* Manage cross-team projects and ad hoc business initiatives as business needs evolve, executing across multiple disciplines simultaneously
* Support recognition and awards programs, including stakeholder coordination and end-to-end project management
* Provide operational support to multiple leadership team members, shifting context quickly as priorities change
* Drive business planning processes and support the development and tracking of KPIs and strategic initiatives

**Requirements:**

* 4+ years of business program or project management experience, including end-to-end ownership of cross-team programs
* 4+ years of executive communications and content development experience, producing leadership-grade materials
* 3+ years of hands-on OKR and business performance tracking experience, including tooling and dashboard management
* Prior experience supporting senior leadership or executive offices in an operational or Chief of Staff–type capacity
* Minimum 12 months of continuous tenure in a comparable role is required

* Bachelor's degree required; field of study is flexible but degree is a non-negotiable requirement
* Master's degree preferred
* Ability to pass a Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire and every two years thereafter
* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements as applicable to this role

The Epic Project Manager will work closely with the Epic Application Analyst Team, Epic Training Team, Business Intelligence Teams and system-wide Project Management Offices, as well as operational and clinical leaders, to implement, monitor, and improve Epic-related initiatives.

As a member of the Epic Project Management Office, core expectations will include adhering to and optimizing standardized approaches to project management, including but not limited to, developing and maintaining project schedules, controlling scope, monitoring budget, identifying and mitigating risks, and serving as a strategic thinking partner within the project team.

The Epic Project Manager will also coordinate ongoing Epic workgroups, which are responsible for Epic change requests and optimizations, new feature review and prioritization during upgrades, and issue mitigation. Build alignment. Drive decisions. Turn complex projects into results.

This is a hands-on project management role supporting primarily operational improvement and transformation initiatives across a global organization. You’ll work across functions and alongside technical teams, and third-party vendors to manage multiple projects from ideation to benefits realization.

Join Dura‑Line, an Orbia Connectivity Solutions business, where we create solutions that connect people and information across the globe. * Communicate complex information clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge and organizational experience.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Project Management, or another relevant field.

* Advanced project management fundamentals and experience independently owning projects from ideation through benefits realization.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

We are currently seeking a Sr. Manager, Security Operations to lead our Global Security Operations team within Addepar's Information Security & Risk organization. In this role, you will own the day-to-day running of our detection and response function, act as incident commander for security incidents, and partner with our 24/7 MSSP to ensure threats are identified and handled quickly. You will set the operational objectives and strategy for Security Operations, lead and grow a global team, and shape our detection strategy for threats specific to Addepar's environment. Beyond the immediate response, you will make sure we learn from every incident by driving post-incident follow-through, turning incident trends into lasting fixes with partners across the business, and reporting on the health of the program to Security leadership. We also want this leader to modernize how Security Operations works, applying AI and automation (AIOps) to speed up triage, investigation and response so the team can focus on the highest-impact work. The successful candidate is a hands-on leader who brings structure, calm and accountability to high-pressure situations.

* **Documentation & Playbooks:** Build and own our incident response documentation, including playbooks, runbooks and training materials, and keep it current as threats and our environment evolve
* **Post-Incident Accountability:** Maintain our post-incident process so action items are clearly owned, tracked and closed across teams, covering both immediate fixes and longer-term improvements
* **Root Cause Remediation:** Use incident trends to identify recurring root causes, and partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security and Product teams to prioritize and deliver preventive fixes
* **Metrics, KPIs & Reporting:** Define and track key SecOps metrics and KPIs, and present a holistic monthly view of the Security Operations function to senior leadership

#### **Who You Are**

* You have 8+ years of experience in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response

**Network Security Engineer**

GuidePoint Security is seeking an individual to support the Detection and Automation Engineering (DAE) program by designing, implementing, and maintaining automated/Super Intelligence security detection, integration capabilities across enterprise security monitoring technologies. The individual will strengthen threat detection and response through detection engineering, security automation, systems integration, data analysis, super intelligent and continuous improvement of detection content and workflows. The role requires close collaboration with security operations, threat intelligence, and incident response stakeholders, along with strong documentation and operationalization practices.

**About the Federal Region**

GuidePoint Security is the trusted partner that defense and civilian government agencies rely on to lead their cybersecurity efforts and protect their organizations. Bloomberg’s Post Trade Implementation team helps financial institutions implement technology supporting critical trading, compliance and post-trade workflows.

We work across transaction cost analysis, trade surveillance, regulatory reporting, communications capture and other enterprise solutions, partnering with clients from initial solution design through production launch.

Experience delivering client-facing implementation, onboarding, consulting or technology projects from discovery through production readiness  

Strong project-management skills, including planning, governance, risk and dependency management, change control, stakeholder coordination and escalation  
Experience gathering requirements, analyzing complex business or technical workflows and translating them into clear and deliverable scope

Senior Business Analyst – Commercial Banking, Core Banking & Lending Technology

The Senior Business Analyst will serve as a strategic liaison across Commercial and Private Banking, Operations, Technology, Compliance, Risk, Data Governance, implementation partners, and other crossfunctional teams. This role requires a high-caliber professional with strong commercial banking, core banking, and lending experience; advanced data analysis skills using SQL and Python; hands-on familiarity with relevant technology platforms; and the ability to translate complex business needs into clear functional, non-functional, technical, data, reporting, control, and integration requirements. The analyst will support end-to-end solution delivery, leverage data-driven insights to identify business and operational improvement opportunities, recommend practical solutions, develop business use cases, perform production incident root-cause analysis, and provide subject matter expertise while ensuring solutions align with bank objectives, regulatory expectations, auditability, and industry-standard delivery practices.

Primary Responsibilities:

* Partner with Commercial Banking, Front Office, Operations, Credit, Loan Operations, Treasury, Compliance, Risk, Data Governance, CISO, IT, and vendor teams to elicit, analyze, and document business, functional, non-functional, technical, data, reporting, control, and integration requirements.

* Lead discovery sessions, workshops, walkthroughs, and decision meetings with senior stakeholders, ensuring clear outcomes, documented decisions, issue escalation, and timely follow-through.

* Define current- and target-state processes, system flows, interface specifications, source-totarget mappings, data lineage, transformation rules, data conversion/reconciliation requirements, ETL requirements, exception handling, and operational controls in accordance with SDLC and governance standards.

* Analyze impacts across core banking platforms, commercial loan origination and servicing systems, collateral, pricing, payments, GL/accounting, treasury/cash management, regulatory reporting, data warehouse, and upstream/downstream interfaces.

* Identify opportunities through data analysis to simplify, standardize, automate, and optimize commercial banking and loan operations processes; develop business and operational use cases; and recommend solutions that improve data quality, operational efficiency, client experience, audit readiness, and risk management.

* Perform data analysis using SQL, Python, Excel, and reporting tools to identify trends, generate actionable insights, support data-driven decision making, validate business rules, reconcile data, investigate defects, and support conversion/migration activities.

* Develop clear, well-written business requirements, functional specifications, non-functional requirements, interface requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, report specifications, test scenarios, traceability matrices, operating procedures, executive-ready summaries, and implementation-support documentation.

* Support production incidents through hands-on root-cause analysis across business processes, data flows, interfaces, batch jobs, APIs, reports, and dependencies; document impacts, remediation options, and preventive controls.

* Provide subject matter expertise on commercial banking, lending, core banking processes, system behavior, data dependencies, controls, and integration touchpoints to guide solution design, SIT/UAT, defect triage, implementation decisions, go-live readiness, and postimplementation support.

* Hands-on proficiency with SQL and Python for data extraction, profiling, cleansing, transformation, reconciliation, validation, root-cause analysis, migration/conversion support, and automation of repeatable analysis tasks.

* Demonstrated experience with integration analysis across APIs, batch files, middleware, ETL processes, data feeds, vendor platforms, downstream reporting environments, and exception/error-handling scenarios.

* Hands-on familiarity with application, integration, data, reporting, and operational technology stacks, with the ability to analyze issues independently, ask precise technical questions, and contribute effectively without handholding.

* Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to leverage data to drive business decisions, identify operational improvement opportunities, develop compelling business cases, recommend practical solutions, influence outcomes, and operate as a senior individual contributor.

jobs.description:
**Senior Data Analyst**
-----------------------

Current is a leading consumer fintech platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans with over five million members. We provide access to financial solutions that seamlessly work together to solve the needs of our members and enable all Americans to build better financial futures. Based in NYC, our results-driven environment drives us to build better products, grow faster and empower everyone on our team to have an impact on our business and mission to improve financial outcomes.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to play a central role in how we build, govern, and scale our analytics function. You will work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to own data models, drive analytical initiatives, and ensure the business has reliable, well-defined data to make decisions from. This is a high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of data engineering rigour and business-facing analytics - suited to someone who is equally comfortable shaping a governance framework as they are presenting insight to a non-technical audience.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own and evolve our core data models, ensuring the analytics layer accurately reflects business logic across the company’s unit economics model.
* Partner directly with leadership and cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Finance) to scope, prioritize, and deliver data-driven initiatives.
* Own data quality and reliability across the analytics platform - defining standards, implementing tests, and ensuring models are trustworthy before they reach consumers.
* Provide clear, actionable insight to stakeholders on business performance, customer behaviour, and metric trends - translating complex data into decisions.
* Take ownership of reconciliation workflows, cross-checking mart outputs against source systems and flagging discrepancies.
* Support the broader team with ad hoc analytics requests, with each task building domain context across Current’s metrics and business logic.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and Looker explores that track KPIs across product, finance, and operations.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

* 5+ years in a data analytics role where you owned multiple concurrent workstreams and operated with a high degree of autonomy.
* At least 2–3 years in a consumer-facing fintech, digital banking, payments, or lending environment, working closely with transactional data, product metrics, and customer behavior at scale.
* Proven track record of taking analytical projects from scoping through to delivery, with ownership over outcomes not just outputs. Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders and leadership.
* Technical proficiency across the modern data stack**.** Advanced SQL in a cloud data warehouse environment (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) - window functions, CTEs, and complex joins. Hands-on experience with dbt or a comparable transformation tool. Working knowledge of Looker or a comparable BI/semantic layer.
* Python for scripting and automation. Comfortable writing Python to manipulate data, flag anomalies, and automate repeatable analytical tasks.

**Additional Skills and Qualifications**
----------------------------------------

* Familiarity with Unit Economics concepts - ARPU, contribution profit, cohort LTV, interchange - or experience working with transaction-level data at scale.
* Experience working in environments where data accuracy and auditability matter - validating outputs and tracing metric definitions across systems.
* Looker experience is ideal; any hands-on experience building explorers, views, or governed metric layers on top of a mart layer is valuable.
* Experience contributing to roadmaps, running cross-functional workstreams, or sitting alongside leadership in shaping how analytical work gets structured and prioritised - even informally.
  

This role has a base salary range of $150,000-$200,000. Compensation is determined based on experience, skill level, and qualifications, which are assessed during the interview process. * Own the product analytics agenda for your embedded area, partnering with product, engineering, finance, and business leaders to scope, prioritize, and deliver high-impact analyses.
* Lead the design, execution, and interpretation of experiments, including success metrics, power and sample sizing, statistical inference, and learning briefs.
* Conduct deep-dive and root-cause analyses on trends, funnels, retention, and engagement, turning ambiguous problems into clear business opportunities.
* Build business cases that size opportunities, quantify impact, and inform investment and roadmap decisions.
* Help department leaders define success metrics and strategic roadmaps grounded in data.
* Provide clear, actionable insight to stakeholders on business performance, customer behavior, and metric trends, and present findings and recommendations to leadership.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and Looker explores that track KPIs across product, finance, and operations.
* Partner with analytics engineers and data engineers to improve data models, definitions, and reliability, and to validate outputs before they reach stakeholders.
* Use AI tools to improve efficiency in analysis, insight generation, and reporting, and share best practices with the team.
* Mentor and support other analysts, contributing to team standards for analysis design, experimentation, and storytelling.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years in a data analytics role, with at least 3 years in product analytics, where you owned multiple concurrent workstreams and operated with a high degree of autonomy.
* 2-3 years in a consumer-facing fintech, digital banking, payments, or lending environment (or similar B2C setting), working with transactional data, product metrics, and customer behavior at scale.
* Advanced SQL in a cloud data warehouse environment (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift), including window functions, CTEs, and complex joins.
* Python experience for data analysis, automation, and statistical work.
* Strong expertise in experimentation, including A/B/n testing, significance testing, and statistical inference.
* Proven track record of taking analytical projects from scoping through to delivery, with ownership over outcomes, not just outputs.
* Experience building dashboards and reports in Looker or comparable BI tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders and leadership.
* A proven ability to use data to change minds and drive decisions.

* Direct experience in D2C or consumer fintech, including banking, liquidity, or value-added services.
* Experience building business cases and contributing to roadmaps or strategic planning.

* Experience using AI tools to improve analytics efficiency and insight generation.

jobs.description:
**Description**

### **Illuminate Emerging Adversary Campaigns Across the Pacific Cyberspace Frontier**

Leidos is seeking an experienced, analytical **Cyber Threat Analyst** to join our Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO) team supporting Defense Information Systems Agency Pacific (DISA PAC) at Ford Island, Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, HI. Operating under the Global Services Management – Operations II (GSM-O II) Task Order 22 (TN22) Boundary Cyber Defense and Cybersecurity Services Provider (CSSP) contract, our mission is to defend the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN/DISN), U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM), and critical mission partner enclaves against sophisticated advanced persistent threats and nation-state cyber actors.

In this high-impact intelligence and analysis role, you will synthesize multi-source intelligence, telemetry, and forensic data into actionable threat intelligence. You will analyze adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), formulate threat indicators, track advanced adversary campaigns, and direct threat-informed defense operations across perimeter boundaries, multi-cloud platforms, and classified networks—spanning Unclassified (NIPRNet) and Secret (SIPRNet) up to Top Secret/SCI.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **1. Boundary Threat Analysis & Adversary Characterization**

* **Warning Intelligence & Attack Sensing:** Analyze boundary sensor feeds, Netflow, and IDS/IPS logs in conjunction with intelligence agencies, peer CSSPs, and commercial intelligence providers to deliver Warning Intelligence and Attack Sensing and Warning activities compliant with DoDI 8530.01.
* **Adversary Campaign Tracking:** Apply the **MITRE ATT&CK®** and Cyber Kill Chain frameworks to characterize adversary behavior, track campaign evolution, identify "Living off the Land" (LotL) tradecraft, and assess the operational impact of targeted threats traversing enterprise Internet Access Points and Boundary Cloud Access Points.
* **Actionable Battlefield Intelligence:** Author, refine, and disseminate high-impact, actionable battlefield cyber threat analysis products, Threat Warnings, and Tippers that empower tactical defenders and boundary engineers to preempt emerging cyber assaults.
* **Automated Telemetry & Breach Assessment:** Evaluate bypasses and telemetry from automated blocking platforms to uncover adversary evasion techniques, evaluate malicious patterns, and generate targeted analytic hypotheses.
* **Operational Reporting & DJOC Synchronization:** Coordinate closely with the DISA Joint Operations Center (DJOC), USPACOM J6, DoD Cyber Defense Command (DCDC), USCYBERCOM, and the National Security Agency (NSA) to synchronize threat analyses and maintain standardized incident reporting in the DoD-mandated reporting structure (currently Rally).

### **2. Enterprise CSSP Intelligence & Proactive Threat Hunting**

* **Deliberate Defense (DD) & Discovery Counter Infiltration (DCI):** Formulate threat hypotheses based on all-source intelligence, reconstruct multi-stage adversary attack paths, and conduct structured threat-hunting across enterprise endpoints and cloud enclaves to validate malicious presence or confirm its absence.
* **Multi-Cloud & Zero Trust Threat Analysis:** Track advanced persistent threats operating against enterprise cloud ecosystems (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) secured under the Joint Warfighter Cloud Capability, Thunderdome Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and Microsoft Defender suite (EndGuard).
* **Analytic Capability & Use Case Development:** Translate threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into specific detection use cases, rule logic, and detection requirements for ingestion into enterprise SIEMs (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, and JCRS-D).
* **Aggregated Threat Trend Reporting:** Aggregate threat indicators, malware behaviors, and adversary profiles from commercial threat feeds (e.g., CrowdStrike, VirusTotal) and internal investigations; provide inputs for the quarterly Aggregated Cyber Awareness Report detailing strategic threat forecasts and vulnerability exposures.
* **Vulnerability & Exposure Intelligence:** Continuously assess Information Assurance Vulnerability Management notices (IAVAs and IAVBs) against active adversary exploitation trends, providing technical threat context and impact assessments to mission partner enclaves.

### **3. Location-Specific & Above-Secret Intelligence: PACOM & TS/SCI**

* **PACOM Mission Network (PMN) and Joint Operational Edge – Coalition Environment (JOE-CE) Threat Assessment:** Provide dedicated cyber threat intelligence and behavioral profiling tailored to the PMN and JOE-CE operational networks.
* **User & Entity Behavioral Profiling:** Analyze Identity, Credential, and Access Management telemetry and the PMN Master User Record to identify anomalous user behavior, insider threats, and sophisticated lateral movement.
* **SCIF-Based Intelligence Operations:** Conduct all-source cyber analysis within Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIF) at Ford Island, examining multi-discipline intelligence across JWICS, YLAN, and special-access enclaves up to Top Secret / SCI.
* **Cross-Echelon Coordination:** Brief Senior Executive and military leadership across USPACOM, DISA PAC, and operational mission partners on adversary threat capabilities, active campaigns, and strategic risk postures.

**What You’ll Need for Success**
--------------------------------

### **Clearance & Citizenship**

* **Citizenship:** Must be a U.S. Citizen.
* **Clearance:** Active **Top Secret** security clearance with eligibility to obtain SCI access upon start (adjudicated Tier 5 / SSBI investigation within scope). *Candidates holding an active Secret clearance may be considered provided Top Secret/SCI processing begins immediately upon hire with government approval.*

jobs.title: Operations Officer (Senior Internet Technology Project Manager)
jobs.description:
Our team provides superior services, solutions and subject matter expertise to solve our customer's most challenging requirements in cyber, land, air, sea and space. We believe in empowering our employees to deliver exceptional results across our federal, state and private sector clients. We are values-led and mission driven. We can't wait to work with you!

**About the role**

This position is in the Secretariat for Special Operations (SSO), Office of the Assistant Secretary of War for Special Operations and Low-Intensity Conflict (OASW(SO/LIC)). The ASW(SO/LIC) serves as the principal civilian advisor and assistant to the Secretary of War and has statutory responsibility for overseeing special operations-peculiar administrative matters pertaining to the readiness and organization of special operations forces (SOF), resources and equipment, and civilian personnel.

The Operations Officer (Senior IT Project Manager) serves as the primary technical authority, acquisition advisor, and execution lead for secure systems modernization and cybersecurity governance across the SSO, reporting directly to the SSO CIO / EDS Chief. In this capacity, the Operations Officer provides direct oversight of the Enterprise Digital Services (EDS) contractor team to ensure strict alignment with the transition strategy. The primary focus of this role is to govern the decommissioning of the legacy .gov network and Data Center, while directing the lifecycle management and acquisition of modern, secure, and compliant cloud capabilities within the DOW-approved Microsoft 365 and SharePoint Online environments. The Manager works directly with resource managers, technical teams, and vendors to monitor service-level agreements (SLAs), evaluate technical deliverables, and enforce low-code/no-code Microsoft Power Platform standards.

*Travel frequency is up to 10%, with travel between Washington, D.C., and U.S. Special Operations Command for limited functions and coordination.*

**What you'll do**

* **Technical Project Lifecycle & Governance Execution:** Acts as the lead integrator and technical authority for all IT systems, infrastructure upgrades, and enterprise software deployments across the organization. This role directs the full project management lifecycle—from requirement elicitation and work breakdown scheduling through deployment and operational transition. The Manager actively establishes technical baselines, monitors project velocity, eliminates delivery roadblocks, and enforces standard operating procedures (SOPs) and configuration control to ensure predictable, secure, and compliant project milestones.
* **Cybersecurity Posture, Compliance & ISSM Alignment:** The Manager provides subject matter expertise in information security governance, supporting Information System Security Manager (ISSM) functions and security assessment processes. Core duties include coordinating Risk Management Framework (RMF) accreditation packages, monitoring continuous diagnostic and mitigation (CDM) baselines, and evaluating technical architecture against strict cybersecurity standards. The role conducts vulnerability reviews, oversees system authorization artifacts (ATO/IATT), liaises with defense authorizing officials, and ensures all network enclaves and sensitive processing environments remain strictly compliant with applicable security directives.
* **Stakeholder Synchronization, Vendor Oversight & Technical Advisory:** The role drives cross-functional technical synchronization by translating intricate operational needs into actionable engineering specifications and procurement packages. Working directly with government resource managers, systems engineers, and defense contractors, the Manager oversees vendor performance, service-level agreements (SLAs), and hardware/software asset lifecycle roadmaps. Additionally, they advise the SSO CIO on emerging technologies, leads technical working groups, document key engineering decisions, and direct technical onboarding and transition activities to ensure new capabilities integrate seamlessly into operational workflows.
* **Acquisition Oversight & Lifecycle Management:** Serve as the primary Government oversight authority and Technical Representative for EDS acquisition, procurement, and lifecycle-management activities. This includes translating SSO business requirements into formal procurement packages, evaluating vendor technical proposals for Microsoft 365 and SharePoint suitability, and conducting rigorous lifecycle reviews of contractor deliverables. The Manager ensures that the contractor utilizes native Microsoft Power Platform configurations (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate) rather than establishing costly, non-standard custom software baselines, thereby mitigating long-term maintenance costs and technical debt.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility. U.S. Citizenship required.
* Deep technical subject matter expertise in enterprise IT lifecycle management, IT acquisition, and cloud governance, **with specific expertise in evaluating, acquiring, and securing Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and Power Platform enterprise structures.** Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-37/800-53, Risk Management Framework (RMF) for cloud enclaves, DoD IT/Cyber directives, and federal IT acquisition regulations.
* Demonstrated experience providing direct technical oversight to defense contractors, monitoring SLA metrics (such as help desk response and resolution times), and serving as a direct advisor to Senior Executive Service (SES) or Flag Officer-level IT leadership.
* Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary technical teams, manage high-stakes IT delivery schedules, translate technical risks into executive-level decision briefs, and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous, high-tempo mission environments.
* 15 to 20+ years of progressive experience in IT project management, enterprise systems integration, or informa

* Assists with the development and management of division budget and contract management.

* Supervise and mentor security personnel, including scheduling and shift coverage, performance feedback, skills development, and ensuring consistent adherence to policies, procedures, and operational standards.
* Coordinate the integration, maintenance, and optimization of security technologies and systems (e.g., access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, duress/panic systems, mass notification platforms) used to support County safety and security operations in conjunction with the Security Operations Center (SOC).
* Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and other operational metrics for Security Program performance; prepare routine and ad hoc reports for leadership, highlighting trends, emerging risks, and recommendations for mitigation.

* Serve as the primary liaison between the Security Program and internal stakeholders (e.g., departments, facility managers, HR, IT) as well as external partners (e.g., law enforcement, regional emergency management, contractors) to coordinate information sharing and joint response efforts.
* Ensure the Security Program operates in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, County policies, and industry best practices related to physical security, privacy, records retention, and emergency management.
* Develop and deliver security-related training and exercises for security staff and relevant County personnel, including scenario-based drills, table-top exercises, and orientation to Security Program capabilities and processes.
* Support Emergency Operations Center (EOC) activations by providing situational awareness, security assessments, and real-time facility security status in conjunction with the SOC; may staff designated leadership or support roles within the EOC structure.
* Conduct threat and vulnerability assessments, leveraging data and analytics to identify patterns, vulnerabilities, and opportunities to strengthen facility and operational security.

The Senior Intelligence Analyst serves as an investigative researcher, fusing commercial data, law enforcement holdings, and open-source information into lead and intelligence packages that agents and protective details can act on within the same shift. Supporting the Bureau of Diplomatic Security (DS) under the OASIS program, the role supports criminal investigations, passport and visa fraud, fugitive location, and protective intelligence for DS protectees and U.S. embassies, consulates, and facilities worldwide. This is an SME position that carries a full research load, sets the standard for tradecraft and product quality, and coordinates a small team through high-tempo surges.

  

**Key Responsibilities** (Principal Duties and Accountabilities \*Essential Functions)

* Fuse commercial investigative databases, law enforcement systems, public records, social media, and other open sources to identify, locate, and confirm subjects of interest.

jobs.description:
*Your Role at RedZone Technologies*

At RedZone Technologies, we’re looking for a Project Manager to join our Annapolis-based team and own the delivery of technology projects, managed services onboardings, and cybersecurity service engagements for clients throughout Maryland, D.C., and Northern Virginia. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you will manage your own portfolio of client engagements end to end — scheduling and logistics included — and work closely with engineers, security consultants, and support teams to get them done.

You will be accountable for delivering onboardings, implementations, projects, and security assessment engagements on time, within budget, and with high customer satisfaction. You will make sure clients are handed off cleanly to our support teams. This role has no direct reports and does not own sales, quoting, or technical architecture. You own making sure what was sold and planned actually gets delivered.

*What You’ll Do*

Own Delivery Outcomes

* Deliver every client onboarding, implementation, and project on time, within its hours budget, and with high customer satisfaction.
* Monitor schedules, hours against budget, and task progress across your active work. Identify risk early and act before it reaches the client.
* Report delivery health to leadership with clear status, risks, and recommendations.

Coordinate Across Teams

* Work with engineers, security consultants/testers, and support teams to set priorities and make sure every engagement has a clear owner and a backup.
* Follow and reinforce documented processes and standards on your engagements, including consistent client communication and timely close-out.
* Raise quality or process concerns with the right owner and leadership instead of absorbing them.
* Build strong working relationships across sales, accounting, engineering, and support so work moves smoothly between teams.

Be Hands-On

* Own a portfolio of concurrent engagements from kick-off through close-out.
* Coordinate onsite work, technical engagements, kick-off and scheduling meetings, and readiness across engineers, vendors, and clients.
* Step in on complex or at-risk engagements to get them back on track.

* Keep project records, status updates, and documentation accurate and current.

Manage Client Onboarding and Hand-Off

* Make sure new managed services clients are onboarded well: clear expectations, complete information gathering, and a scheduled, well-communicated implementation.
* Make sure each service is handed off to the support team with complete documentation, access details, and quality review before it goes live.
* Close out engagements with a clear final hand-off so the client knows exactly who supports them going forward.

Deliver Cybersecurity Service Engagements

* Manage cybersecurity engagements — such as penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, and compliance assessments — from kickoff through report delivery, client review, and close-out.
* Run kickoff calls, gather required client information, and coordinate consultants, testing schedules, and equipment logistics so engagements start and finish on time.
* Make sure every deliverable completes internal quality review before it reaches the client, and coordinate the delivery of reports and findings, including scheduling and supporting client review calls.
* Provide proactive status updates throughout each engagement so clients always know where things stand, and flag client-side delays early rather than absorbing them.
* Handle sensitive client information (such as IP addresses, physical locations, and access details) securely and only through approved systems — never over unsecured channels.

Improve How We Work

* Identify and propose process improvements, and see them through implementation.
* Run lessons-learned reviews on completed engagements and use them to raise the quality of future delivery.
* Track and report performance measures for your engagements, including on-time delivery, hours against budget, and client satisfaction.

*What We’re Looking For*

Experience & Education

* 3+ years of project management, project coordination, or delivery management in an MSP or IT services environment.
* Track record of leading cross-functional work and holding others accountable without formal authority.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent client engagements against schedules and hours budgets.

* Working knowledge of IT infrastructure projects (networking, servers, Microsoft 365, and Azure) sufficient to coordinate technical engagements and understand risk. You do not need to be the hands-on engineer.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity services — penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, and compliance frameworks (e.g., CMMC, SOC 2) — is a strong plus. You will coordinate these engagements, not perform the testing.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience considered. PMP or similar certification is a plus.

Core Skills & Traits

* Clear, confident communicator, both verbal and written, with clients, engineers, and leadership.
* Ownership mindset: takes responsibility for outcomes and follows through.
* Sound judgment when prioritizing and making tradeoffs between schedule, budget, and client expectations.
* Ability to influence and align engineers, consultants, and vendors, and to give timely, direct, constructive feedback.
* Highly organized, process-minded, and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through and accountability.
* Ability to build trusting relationships with clients while staying focused on solutions and long-term success.

*Additional Requirements*

* Valid driver’s license in good standing and reliable transportation for occasional client visits throughout MD, DC, and VA.
* Willingness to support occasional after-hours client cutovers or deployments.
* This is a hybrid position based out of Annapolis, MD.

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

U.S. citizens

jobs.description:
**MEDECINS SANS FRONTIERES UK**

Médecins Sans Frontières/Doctors Without Borders (MSF) provides life-saving emergency relief and longer-term medical care to some of the most vulnerable and excluded communities around the world. As an independent medical humanitarian organisation, we deliver care based only on need, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or political affiliation.MSF relies on donations from private individuals and organisations for the majority of its income. This private funding gives MSF the freedom to respond where needs are greatest and to speak out publicly, free from any political interference.

MSF has around 67,000 local and international staff working in over 70 countries, in some of the most challenging places in the world. Our medical humanitarian projects are supported by offices in 44 countries, including the UK and Ireland. These teams recruit staff, organise fundraising, and raise awareness on the humanitarian crises our colleagues are witnessing, as well as running different and diverse support activities. MSF offices are spread across Europe, North and South America, Asia, Africa and Australasia.

At MSF UK/IE, we support MSF's operations by building relationships with our supporters, increasing awareness of our work, raising funds, providing specialist medical expertise, ensuring MSF staff have access to relevant higher education programmes, catalysing change on medical humanitarian issues, and recruiting field staff.

jobs.title: Customer Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
At Flexciton, we work with high-tech factories built with investments worth hundreds of millions of dollars, producing advanced chips at the atomic level. It can take up to nine months to fabricate these cutting-edge products.

We are proud to be the only SaaS product in the world that plans and schedules production in high-tech semiconductor fabs, using complex algorithms in real-time, all from our London office.

Our technology consistently delivers the best production schedules, and leading companies like Seagate trust Flexciton to run their production 24/7. With operations across the US, Europe, and expansion into Asia, we are on a path to realise our vision for the Autonomous Factory.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Customer Implementation Manager owns the end-to-end delivery of our software into enterprise semiconductor manufacturing environments — a highly technical product in a demanding, fast-moving setting where priorities shift and clear thinking under pressure is what generates great customer outcomes. You run complex implementation projects from kickoff to go-live, often across more than one customer at a time depending on project stage, using expert project-management, data, communication and collaboration skills. After rollout, you continue to own the account — maximising the success, adoption and value our software delivers. You will also contribute to the strategic direction of the function, improving processes and ways of working.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Implementation Delivery: Owns the delivery of customer implementation projects end-to-end — coordinating key stakeholders, documentation and plans, and navigating shifting priorities across factory operations, engineering and commercial stakeholders without losing the thread. Drives project success under time constraints. Runs the client engagement cadence (regular calls, QBRs) and coordinates across Product & Engineering to keep delivery on track.
* Product Expertise & Influence: Deep understanding of our applications and all complex features, and how they integrate into each customer's environment. Works with Product and other Client Success team members to translate customer requests into structured requirements.
* Value & Outcome Realisation: Translates factory performance goals into measurable customer value, and ensures that value is realised and evidenced post-rollout. Improves metrics such as time-to-value through more effective delivery.
* Adoption, Health & Renewal Support: Owns customer health and adoption across the account lifecycle, proactively monitoring usage, running check-ins and business reviews, and identifying at-risk accounts early. Surfaces and qualifies renewal risk and expansion opportunities and hands them to Account Management.
* Risk & Escalation Management: Acts as the customer's technical anchor during difficult periods, diagnosing issues under time pressure, coordinating Product & Engineering to resolution, and maintaining executive trust throughout.

**What success looks like in this role**
----------------------------------------

* You independently manage and deliver complex implementation projects end-to-end, typically spanning 9–15 months.
* Your accounts reach go-live on time and on scope, with adoption and measurable value evidenced after rollout.
* You become the client's trusted technical anchor, trusted to hold the relationship through difficult moments.
* Over time, you carry multiple accounts and lead full deployments as independent lead.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

* Time-to-value and on-time / on-scope project delivery
* Product adoption and active usage across the account
* Customer health and retention (renewal readiness, identified expansion opportunities)
* Overall customer satisfaction and sentiment

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

Essential

* STEM master's degree — or equivalent capability demonstrated through relevant experience.
* Complex implementation experience: demonstrable experience leading complex, 9-15 months software implementations end-to-end.
* Dynamic-environment experience: experience in manufacturing/industrial software or at a SaaS company, in a fast-changing environment.

Skills & Competencies

* Project management and associated tooling (monday.com)
* Data analytics & problem-solving (Tableau, Python, JMP, PG SQL)
* Fluency with modern AI tooling (Claude Code) and productivity-suite integrations
* Strategic thinking & leadership
* Client communication & interpersonal skills; fluency in additional languages welcome
* Familiarity with CRM and customer-success tooling an advantage

Domain Knowledge

* Deep domain knowledge in either semiconductor manufacturing or scheduling/planning software is preferred
* Familiarity with concepts of Factory Physics is preferred

**Profile fit**
---------------

* Performs best under pressure: strong reasoning, able to think and communicate clearly, prioritise and make sound calls in time-critical moments.
* Leadership & ownership: leads by example and takes end-to-end ownership of outcomes; a can-do operator who drives momentum and owns results, with or without formal authority.
* Resilient in a dynamic project environment: shifting priorities, proactive, strong self-management.
* Commercially aware: able to spot and articulate where the customer is getting value and where risk or growth is emerging.
* Flexibility: willing to adjust work hours to address time-zone differences with a globally distributed customer base.
* Travel: able to travel internationally (15–25%).

Above all, we are looking for curious and motivated individuals that are eager to grow while changing the face of semiconductor manufacturing. If this sounds like you, even if you don’t feel like you meet all the criteria above, apply today and help us build the future.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary based on skills and experience
* L&D Opportunities

Could you cover a broad range of security domains, including vulnerability management, secure operations, identity and access management, cyber threat intelligence, network monitoring and intrusion detection, and incident response?

* Support the vulnerability management process by running automated vulnerability scans on networks and systems, identifying vulnerabilities from scanner outputs, and performing an initial assessment of severity and impact.
* Work with resolving teams to track remediation of vulnerabilities, following up with system owners and verifying that critical vulnerabilities are resolved within expected time frames.
* Respond to cyber security service requests and incidents logged in IT service management (ITSM) tools, ensure that tickets are appropriately categorised, prioritised, and actioned in line with agreed service levels (SLAs).
* Engage proactively in on-the-job training and development, recognising that this is an entry-level role with a steep learning curve.

**To be a successful Junior Cyber Security Analyst, what will you need?**

* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail, able to approach problems systematically, gather relevant data, and assist in troubleshooting technical issues under guidance.
* Methodical approach to following procedures, handling multiple tasks, and meeting agreed deadlines or response time targets.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
As a **Business Analyst,** you will play a key role within the Digital and Transformation teams at Thames Water, supporting the delivery of business and technology change initiatives that enable the organisation to achieve its strategic objectives.

Working closely with Project Managers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and business stakeholders, you will help ensure solutions meet business needs and align with Thames Water’s governance and delivery frameworks. You will gather, analyse, and document requirements while supporting teams to deliver outcomes that drive value across people, processes, and technology.

This role contributes to Thames Water’s digital transformation by identifying opportunities for improvement, shaping solutions, and ensuring robust business analysis practices are applied throughout the project lifecycle.

**What you’ll be doing as a Business Analyst**

* Analyse business challenges and opportunities, identifying root causes and recommending practical improvements.
* Support feasibility assessments, option analysis, and business case development, including cost, risk, and benefit evaluation.
* Gather, document, and manage functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, and backlogs in Azure DevOps (ADO).

* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, workshops, and decision-making sessions across business and technical teams.

* Excellent communication and facilitation skills.

Keep global inventory moving. Find the difference. Solve the problem.
  
At TD SYNNEX, we are looking for an organized and detail-focused professional to join our Global Inventory Operations team.
  
In this role, you will help manage stock held across external warehouses in Europe, Asia, and the US. You will track shipments, reconcile stock records, process orders, and investigate differences between our systems and the information provided by our warehouse partners.
  
  
This is a structured, process-driven position for someone who enjoys working with data, following tasks through carefully, and finding the reason when something does not match. You do not need to arrive knowing every system or process. We will provide structured training and support as you learn.
  
  
Why You’ll Love Working Here

* Private healthcare, matched pension, and enhanced parental and family leave
* “Moments that matter” paid time off, even for your pet’s birthday

* A strong commitment to sustainability
* A collaborative culture that values every voice and celebrates different perspectives
* Predominantly home-based working with flexibility around how you organise your day

Own It
  
Grow and Win
  
Dare to Go
  
Do the Right Thing
  
We’re proud to be a Disability Confident employer. If you need adjustments during the recruitment process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Business Analyst (Market Research and Techno-economics)
jobs.description:
Business Analyst (Market Research and Techno-economics)

Location: Cambridge, UK  
Salary: £53,548 per annum + pension  
Hours: Full time  
Contract: Permanent  
Start date: As soon as the right candidate is available  
Closing date: Open until filled

About LeafyColl

LeafyColl is a Cambridge-based biotechnology company producing human-identical proteins in plants. Our first product is bioidentical human collagen, supplied as a B2B ingredient for cosmeceuticals, with medical devices and functional food to follow. We work with contract manufacturers and leading academic and industry partners. We are a small, collaborative and fast-moving team where everyone has real ownership of their work and a direct impact on the business.

The Role

We are looking for a Business Analyst to provide the research, data and financial analysis behind LeafyColl’s commercial and growth decisions. You will design and run market and stakeholder research, analyse data rigorously, build cost and financial models, and turn your findings into clear recommendations for our leadership team, partners, investors and funders. You will also coordinate suppliers and project reporting across our commercial and collaborative R&D activities.

Our primary requirement is strong business research and quantitative analysis skills, with proven experience of designing studies, collecting primary data and turning results into recommendations.

You will:

* Design and carry out market and customer research, including surveys, questionnaires and stakeholder interviews with brands, manufacturers, clinicians and partners.
* Analyse quantitative and qualitative data using statistical methods, and present findings in clear reports and presentations.
* Analyse our target markets (cosmeceuticals, medical devices and functional food), including market size, segments, competitors, pricing and barriers to adoption.
* Build and maintain financial and cost models, including unit economics, pricing, cost of goods and sensitivity analysis, working with our scientific team on production data.
* Support techno-economic and sustainability analysis, including collecting process data for cost and life-cycle assessments that compare our proteins with animal-derived and fermentation-derived alternatives.
* Assess business models, including ingredient supply and licensing, and turn customer insight and our partner pipeline into demand forecasts and go-to-market recommendations.
* Coordinate suppliers, contract manufacturers and logistics, tracking costs, timelines and performance.
* Support LeafyColl’s collaborative R&D projects, including research and analysis for grant applications, project reports, and budget and milestone tracking.
* Carry out literature and policy reviews on markets, regulation and sustainability to inform strategy.
* Prepare evidence, models and presentations for strategic planning, board reporting, fundraising and partner discussions.

Essential Skills, Experience and Qualifications

* A master’s degree in international business, business, finance, economics, management or a related discipline.
* Experience of designing surveys or questionnaires and collecting primary quantitative and qualitative data.
* Strong statistical analysis skills using SPSS or similar software, and good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
* Sound understanding of finance, accounting or financial analysis.
* Experience writing research reports and presenting findings to professional or academic audiences.
* Experience of working with stakeholders and suppliers, and of managing your own workload and projects independently.

Desirable Skills

* Advanced statistical methods, such as regression or structural equation modelling (for example with SmartPLS).
* Experience of running or managing operations in a small business, including scheduling, budgets and vendor relationships.
* Systematic literature review and reference management (for example EndNote or Mendeley).
* Interest in, or experience of, biotechnology, life sciences or sustainability, including life-cycle assessment.
* Experience contributing to grant-funded or academic research projects.

You do not need every desirable skill to apply. Training in sector-specific tools will be provided.

What We Offer

* £53,548 per annum, plus company pension.
* A permanent, full-time position.
* Broad exposure across science, operations, commercial strategy and fundraising in a fast-paced, collaborative start-up.
* Professional development, training and work with leading academic and industry partners.

How to Apply

Please email the following to Dr Ejaz Hussain at ejaz@leafycoll.co.uk, using the subject line “Business Analyst application”:

* Your CV.
* A cover letter (maximum two pages) explaining how you meet the essential criteria, with one or two examples of research or analysis you have personally carried out, the methods you used and how your findings informed decisions.

Interviews will include a short presentation on a piece of research or analysis you have carried out.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Informal enquiries are welcome at the same email address.

LeafyColl is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds. Personal data submitted with applications will be used only for recruitment and handled in line with UK GDPR.

Pay: £48,548.00-£53,548.00 per year

Work Location: In person
